ppt-rescue-kit 0.1.0

- Initial release of the PPT Rescue Kit skill for rapidly creating or finishing editable PowerPoint presentations (.pptx) for work updates, proposals, or knowledge sharing, starting from a topic or incomplete deck.
- Delivers complete slide text, speaker notes, structured sources (with IDs and details), and revision tracking— not just a slide outline.
- Requires a JishuDB backend for persistence and host with compatible PowerPoint generation capabilities; blocks with a clear message if required components are missing.
- Follows a strict approval and audit process for sourcing, editing, output directory allocation, and document citation, ensuring each output is editable, well-documented, and rights-compliant.
- Not intended for industry analysis decks requiring automated report discovery or for website requests (delegated to specific alternative skills).
